scope: Preserve every effective local modification at the local tip. Earlier superseded experiments remain in parent history and are not reintroduced into current source.
runtime_acceptance_pending: Video A -> related video B -> back to A was attempted but not accepted: another test app (com.pixel.gallery.multitask.test) took the foreground, and a Google Play services ANR dialog appeared. These captures are excluded from passing evidence.
Live playback, authenticated account actions, physical OnePlus power consumption, long-duration playback and non-Android platforms were not runtime-tested.

Both Android PiP paths were observed separately with videos, screenshots and system state. Contact sheets sample at 4 fps; this does not establish absence of every transient frame glitch or resolve the previously documented settled-jump issue.
review_method: The conservative 100-path inventory includes all 72 actual local changes. Unchanged files and deletions are verified by content hashes; crossed changes were reviewed against local diffs; four player files were adapted to upstream APIs, with owner/revision barriers and local defaults retained. Unit tests and build results do not imply exhaustive behavioral proof.
